popCulture.title: Argia (daughter of Adrastus)
popCulture.description: Adrastus' daughter and wife of Polynices — Argive royalty at the heart of the Seven against Thebes and the Epigoni return.

popCulture.title: Thebaid
popCulture.creator: Statius
popCulture.description: Statius' epic of the Theban war keeps Argia among the Argive women who defy Creon to bury the Seven — a Roman afterlife for Adrastus' daughter.
